story: Alex stared at the blinking cursor on his screen, the rhythmic pulse mirroring the erratic thumping in his chest. He checked his watch for the third time in as many minutes, noting with a jolt that the deadline was creeping closer than he had anticipated. A cold sweat prickled along his hairline, making his collar feel suddenly tight and restrictive against his skin. He stood up abruptly, pacing the small length of his office while his fingers drummed a frantic, staccato rhythm against his thigh. The silence in the room felt heavy, pressing against his eardrums until he could hear his own shallow breaths echoing in the stillness.

Alex stared at the glowing screen, his thumb hovering over the send button like a trapped insect. His heart hammered a frantic rhythm against his ribs, each beat echoing in the silence of the empty room. He deleted the draft for the third time, his fingers trembling slightly as he re-typed the same cautious words. The clock ticked louder with every passing second, a relentless countdown to a moment he desperately wanted to avoid. Sweat beaded on his forehead despite the cool air conditioning, sticking his shirt to his back. He took a shallow breath, holding it until his lungs burned, then finally tapped the button, immediately regretting the irreversible action as the phone slipped from his clammy hand.

Alex stared at the glowing screen, his thumb hovering over the send button for the third time. A cold sweat prickled along his hairline, making the collar of his shirt feel suddenly too tight and restrictive against his skin. He took a shallow breath, holding it until his lungs burned, then exhaled slowly through his nose, trying to steady the rapid thumping in his chest. The cursor blinked rhythmically, a silent metronome counting down the seconds before he had to commit to the irreversible action. He wiped his damp palms on his jeans, glanced at the clock, and finally pressed enter, immediately regretting the decisive click.
